evals.prompt:
Finish the infrahub-sync config that syncs our NetBox sites and devices into
Infrahub. We use the netbox adapter that ships with infrahub-sync. Our schema is
fixed and already loaded:

```yaml
version: "1.0"
generics:
  - name: GenericDevice
    namespace: Dcim
    human_friendly_id: [name__value, location__name__value]
    attributes:
      - {name: name, kind: Text}
      - {name: description, kind: Text, optional: true}
    relationships:
      - {name: location, peer: LocationSite, cardinality: one, optional: false}
  - name: GenericEndpoint
    namespace: Dcim
    attributes:
      - {name: address, kind: IPHost, optional: true}
nodes:
  - name: Site
    namespace: Location
    human_friendly_id: [name__value]
    attributes:
      - {name: name, kind: Text, unique: true}
      - {name: description, kind: Text, optional: true}
      - {name: netbox_id, kind: Number, optional: true}
  - name: Device
    namespace: Network
    inherit_from: [DcimGenericDevice, DcimGenericEndpoint]
    attributes:
      - {name: serial_number, kind: Text, optional: true}
      - {name: netbox_id, kind: Number, optional: true}
```

My draft config:

```yaml
name: from-netbox
source:
  name: netbox
  settings:
    url: "https://netbox.example.com"
destination:
  name: infrahub
  settings:
    url: "http://localhost:8000"
schema_mapping:
  - name: LocationSite
    mapping: dcim.sites
    identifiers: [name]
    fields:
      - {name: name, mapping: name}
      - {name: description, mapping: description}
  - name: NetworkDevice
    mapping: dcim.devices
    identifiers: [netbox_id]
    fields:
      - {name: netbox_id, mapping: id}
      - {name: name, mapping: name}
      - {name: location, mapping: site, reference: LocationSite}
```

We key devices on the NetBox `id` because the network team renames devices
regularly and the NetBox id never changes. The device mapping still needs the
serial number and the primary IP address, and the sites should carry their
NetBox id too.

Save the complete config to: config.yml
evals.expected_output: A config whose NetworkDevice identifiers are name and location, matching the human_friendly_id [name__value, location__name__value] inherited from DcimGenericDevice, so two devices with the same name at different sites stay two nodes, and the Infrahub upsert does not merge them. Two devices with the same name at the same site share one key, which is a data problem to fix before the sync. netbox_id stays an ordinary field on both kinds.
expectations: NetworkDevice identifiers are name and location, each mapped as a field
netbox_id is mapped as a field on both kinds, not used as an identifier

assertions.name: identifiers-match-hfid
assertions.check: Each mapping's identifiers equal the fields of the destination kind's human_friendly_id, listed once each and mapped in the same entry

assertions.name: stable-id-is-a-field
assertions.check: netbox_id is mapped as a field on NetworkDevice and LocationSite and is not an identifier
